Additionally, there is a noticeable texture anomaly (smudging/painting effect) on the dog's upper back (Severity 2.0) and minor geometric flattening of the rear paw (Severity 1.5). While the dog itself is structurally sound (confirmed by pose auditor), the multi-subject interaction failure and texture inconsistencies prevent a higher artifact score.
